purpose: 灯火大排档四页整体重构视觉稿
inputs: 用户提供的旧四页稿、夜市背景、摊位柜台、人物与道具参考图；后续三页以新首页统一材质，修订以新装扮页统一顶部和物品身份。

pages.initial:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE polished full-screen Chinese WeChat casual cooking puzzle game's HOME interface. Deliver a high-resolution tall portrait raster UI screenshot, approx 1024×2048, no phone hardware, no external presentation margins, no comparison panels. This is one of four coordinated redesign pages for 灯火大排档.
Input images roles: Image1 = old FOUR-screen interface reference for existing features and visual personality ONLY, absolutely not a layout to patch. Image2 = reference for riverside Chinese night-market setting; adapt and simplify it, don't reproduce the excessively glossy floor. Image3 = standalone wooden stall counter structure reference. Image4 = cute rounded cook and prop material/style reference. Recompose freely from final visual quality. Keep that recognizable smiling small boy cook with cream puffy chef hat, red apron, wood counter and red/cream awning; make him large enough for facial expression.
Primary request: redesign the HOME page from scratch, premium cozy, round and lovable, warm handmade 2.5D game aesthetic. Beautiful yet immediately usable, clear primary action. Warm red/cream awnings, rounded honey-brown wooden fixtures with soft subdued grain/highlights, midnight teal-blue night, sparse golden lantern lighting. Food and cook are focus. Do not make it corporate, minimalist SaaS, photoreal, flat wireframe, or cluttered game-ad UI.
Composition in this portrait screen:
- Top system safe area leaves right corner clear for native WeChat capsule (render a small neutral capsule at upper-right). Sound and settings ONLY at upper-left, two matching compact cream rounded-square controls. Currency coin pill '384' below the system area to right. No other floating feature icons.
- Centered upper brand sign, graceful perfectly fitted curved wooden plaque, clearly arched red Chinese lettering exactly '灯火大排档'. A narrow cropped awning at top and one lantern at each side, restrained header height about 17% of screen, not huge. Chapter text below logo exactly '河畔夜市 · 第2章', plain small cream type on calm dark night backdrop; no extra broad title strips.
- Main scene occupies roughly y22–64%: a LARGE friendly wooden food stall, full red/cream awning and small integrated plaque '家常现炒', cook clearly visible behind counter, face sizable, holding spatula beside small wok with gentle steam. Counter, serving plate, a couple vegetables, one small green plant and two red stools grounded with consistent perspective and soft contact shadows. Stall occupies about 88% screen width; hero framing is direct and close. Surroundings provide atmospheric riverside night market, softly defocused bridge/water and low-detail side stalls, no second decorative frame around scene. Background light points sparse and less bright than stall. Matte warm wooden ground with subdued reflections. A small cream '布置小摊' brush button sits near scene lower-right without covering character.
- Below scene, one compact horizontal unlocked-next-scene card at y66–73%, pale warm parchment with minimal timber edging, small lantern/scene thumbnail on left. Text '下个场景 竹影河岸', clear currency progress '384 / 1000', thin softly rounded progress bar around38%, small chevron on right. Secondary quiet element, no huge competing CTA, no tiny paragraphs.
- Primary CTA at y77–84%: wide luscious rounded warm vermilion/coral button, soft tactile bevel but controlled specular highlights. Big cream text '开张营业', secondary small line '第29关' inside same button. This must be the strongest interactive control. Under it a quiet text action '查看关卡' with tiny chevron. Generous separation from next-scene card and bottom nav.
- Bottom y91–100%: consistent four-tab medium warm wood navigation rail, comfortable hit targets, matched charming sculpted icons and clear large Chinese labels exactly '小摊' '装扮' '菜谱' '夜市'. Active '小摊' uses a soft cream rounded inset, larger colorful awning icon. Other labels legible and calmer. Respect bottom safe padding, no white margin.
Typography: crisp high-legibility Chinese rounded sans for UI, dark cocoa on cream, cream on red/dark scene; playful display font only for the arched brand. No tiny unreadable text, no random words, no debug labels, no annotations. Text exact. Consistent spacing, aligned edges, substantial breathing room. Entire view is a functional coherent game home screen, not concept art with arbitrary decoration.

Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver ONE polished complete edge-to-edge Chinese casual cooking puzzle WeChat mini-game UI screen, tall portrait approx1024×2048, same aspect as Image1. No phone hardware, no presentation labels/margins, no multiple panels.
Input image roles: Image1 = NEW APPROVED DIRECTION home screen, strictly match its cute rounded2.5D illustrated materials, palette, readable type and bottom navigation components. Image2 = OLD four-page interface for feature inventory ONLY, do not paste its layout. Image3 = cook and object style reference. This screen belongs to same '灯火大排档' game.
Shared style: friendly rounded honey-brown matte wood, cream parchment surfaces, dark cocoa text, vermilion accents, small amber lights and muted dark teal night-market ambience. Restrained soft bevels and grain, no glitter, no gold overload, no busy background behind text, no corporate app design. Strong practical hierarchy, clear large typography, comfortable whitespace, no nested heavy frames. Full screen one complete page. All text must be crisp Chinese and exact; no fabricated filler. Do not add feature icons or systems absent from brief.
Shared compact header: reserve top system region, sound+settings at upper-left, WeChat capsule at upper-right. Below it small curved wood brand '灯火大排档' to left and coin pill '384' to right, whole header height about13%, no giant home logo, no huge hanging red lanterns. Cropped red/cream awning along top is okay, subtle dark night backdrop. Page heading below at about y14% prominent cocoa type on warm cream/wood main area.
Shared bottom nav: same chunky medium warm wood rail as Image1, all4 icons+Chinese labels '小摊' '装扮' '菜谱' '夜市', active item cream rounded inset; do not change ordering or icon family. Fill bottom safe area. Upper content never overlaps nav.
Page: 装扮. Primary request: completely redesign customization to a lucid 'choose part → choose item → preview → equip' flow. Preserve cozy stall identity and large cheerful chef, no redundant categories.
Layout:
- Heading '小摊装扮' with restrained subheading '把小摊布置成喜欢的样子'.
- ONE main category strip4 labels '摊位' '大厨' '场景' '主题', selected '摊位' distinct warm red tab. No second bulky button row.
- Integrated live preview scene y23–53%, 90% width: same riverside stall/cook as new home, same proportions and warm lighting, stage framed only by a subtle shallow rounded inset, not nested frame upon frame. Smaller than home but chef face still readable. Current stall has warm red lanterns. Small cream overlay label at lower-left '预览中' only, avoid duplicate large brand signs in preview; small stall plaque '家常现炒' okay.
- Directly under preview one slim horizontal part selector exactly '灯串' '棚布' '桌饰' '摆件' '招牌', small indicator under selected '灯串', airy text tabs unlike button actions.
- Lower area y58–78% shows a clean 2-column ×2-row inventory grid of four compact cream item cards, each a single chunky lamp icon left/above and readable name/state, balanced equal sizing:
1 '暖红灯串', '使用中' in small muted green check badge.
2 '初点灯火', '已拥有'.
3 '河岸晚风', coin '600'.
4 '满街暖光', coin '1000'.
Card2 is selected for preview, warm red outline and small check in corner; card1 retains small green use badge but no selection outline. Clear owned vs equipped vs purchasable states. Locks only on cards3and4, no confusing owned tag alongside prices.
- One wide warm red action button y82–88% text EXACTLY '换上初点灯火'. Must refer to selected card2, no conflicting selection. No paging buttons, no huge paragraphs, no extra text rows.
- Bottom nav active '装扮'.

Page: 菜谱. Primary request: beautiful highly readable cooking collection page, functional warm cream recipe book styling. Food imagery is main visual focus, restrained wood framing, no giant home stall scene.
Layout:
- Heading '家常菜谱', small clear progress '已收集 20 / 20 道'.
- ONE slim3-tab selector '菜谱' '成就' '相册'; selected '菜谱' warm red small filled rounded tab, other tabs simple.
- Main content y26–80% 2 columns×3 rows = EXACTLY6 generously sized soft cream cards on a calm honey warm wood backing, flatish gentle inset/drop shadows, no separate tiny clip per card and no double borders.
Each card big appealing cooked dish on matching cream round plate in upper2/3 and legible cocoa name below. Subordinate text exactly:
top-left '番茄炒蛋' / '已做28份' — golden/red egg tomato dish.
top-right '青椒肉片' / '已做15份' — green pepper+pork.
middle-left '双料香菇鸡' / '已做17份' — shiitake and chicken.
middle-right '西兰花虾仁' / '已做30份' — broccoli+shrimp.
bottom-left '芹菜牛肉' / '已做16份' — celery+beef.
bottom-right '豆腐炒蛋' / '已做17份' — tofu+egg.
Readable CJK; names NEVER cropped or ellipsized, no decorative ribbons overlapping plates. No per-card action buttons. The sixth food card aligns perfectly.
- Under grid y84–88% quiet '上一页' '1 / 4' '下一页' pagination, first control subdued while next legible, no big CTA.
- Bottom nav active '菜谱'.
